standard-dialogue.npc: Welcome to the vinery. Can I help you?

steps.npc: Let's see... First, you'll need to treat the soil with saltpetre. Dig it into the patch with a trowel. The minerals are good for the fruit.
Then plant a grape seed, and just let it grow. I'll look after it, so it won't get diseased.
When your grapes are ready, pick them and clear the patch so you can grow a new vine.
Does that seem clear, or would you like help with something else?

steps.text: If the player has not completed A Kingdom Divided:

steps.npc: I'm the vintner. I helped Lord Hosidius to develop this land as a vinery, and now it's complete he's put me in charge of production while he works on a new project.
His son, young Pandur, works here too. Pandur checks the wine I produce. But if you've got any questions about the farming, don't ask Pandur. Ask me instead. He checks the wine too much.

steps.text: If the player has completed A Kingdom Divided:

steps.npc: I'm the vintner. I helped the late Lord Hosidius develop this land as a vinery. He put me in charge of production once it was completed.
The new Lord Hosidius used to work here as well. He has new duties of course, but that hasn't stopped him coming down to check the wine I produce.
So can I help you with anything?
It's short for 'Gallows'. When I was young, a boy made some improper suggestions to me, so I grabbed him by his neck and held him in the air until he learnt some manners.
Now, dear, do you need help with the vinery? I'm enjoying the chat, but I have work to do.

treasure-trails.npc: I have a question for you.

treasure-trails.text: Gallow has given you a challenge scroll!

treasure-trails-talking-to-her-with-the-.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.
